_doc: Core character attributes. 10 is average. New characters roll each between roll_min and roll_max.

attributes.name: Constitution
attributes.description: Bodily strength and vitality. Extends lifespan; key for Blacksmiths.

attributes.name: Comprehension
attributes.description: Insight into the Dao. Speeds cultivation; key for Alchemists and Array Masters.

attributes.name: Spirit
attributes.description: Strength of soul and divine sense. Key for Talisman Masters and Doctors.

attributes.name: Fortune
attributes.description: Heaven's favor. Improves breakthrough odds and chance encounters.

attributes.name: Charisma
attributes.description: Presence and persuasion. Key for Beast Tamers and social standing.
